subject: soc-rt
title: SOC.RT.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 104 ((AF)D-32). SOC-RT (social reality) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: RE-DIF (redefinitions), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From CULT-INFO-DY: INFO-RT (information reality) and S-ST (source shift (progressionalism) manipulation). From INFO-RT: MT-IF-DB (multi-informational degree basis) and LK-IMP (linkage implications). From S-ST: PROJ-CONT (projectional continuance).
